comment: Commits that CI and tools/golden.py use. math-exercise: the legacy sources of the goldens (math-exercise 0.10.0's checker files on main; its checker library, question-tests.py and variants.py are byte-identical to the commit the capture was rendered with, which golden.py import-capture checks). ctm-assessment: the umbrella's parity harness (integration/pyodide-parity), which defines the capture: authored_record.py records authored rows (golden.py; its sha256 is pinned too), runtime.cjs boots Pyodide in Node and wheels.cjs fetches SymPy, mpmath and NetworkX checked against Pyodide's lock file (tools/pyodide/verify.cjs).
